card.name: Washing and cleaning chores
card.fires_on: The word wash (or washed, washing, clean) and the words right after it, in household or chore text such as washing a car, dishes, clothes or feet. It also fires on soapy and rinsed in cleaning steps.

modes.label: Wash or clean as a chore
modes.description: The verb wash, washed, washing or clean, at the start of a tip or in a list of chores.
modes.example: -<< Wash>> your car with water from a bucket rather

modes.label: Words right after the cleaning verb
modes.description: A small word or the cleaning object that follows wash or clean, or a cleaning-step word such as soapy or rinsed.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of hand-washing words (wash, hand, sanitizer) as the next word, so it seems to steer away from repeating them.
card.plain: It lights up on everyday talk of washing or cleaning things like cars, dishes and clothes.
